source: Native revision 71 proposal 31b79355 applied to PR39 56f185e; pending coordinator integration and feasibility freeze

feeContract.exactOutput: monotonic gross such that gross minus sum(streamDelta(gross)) equals requestedNet

treasuryControls.unpauseProcessClaims: Treasury-only when no emergency rotation is pending
treasuryControls.scheduleOperationsRotation: Treasury-only; uses the immutable 43200-second delay; clears and freezes ordinary Operations handover; auto-pauses; only a new Treasury intent may supersede it with a fresh delay; history never clears
treasuryControls.executeOperationsRotation: Treasury-only after the scheduled 43200-second delay; replaces Operations and leaves claims paused

xmax.rule: positive integer derived conservatively from the approved launch valuation; never use the USD ceiling as wei

rotation.treasuryReschedule: requires a new Treasury intent and starts a new delay

steps: allocate complete HKMN supply via token.allocate(hook)
approve HKMN only; read slot0 immediately before mint; compute exact native and HKMN debts with pinned TickMath/SqrtPriceMath rounding
bound both debts; send only nativeDebt into PositionManager MINT_POSITION plus SETTLE_PAIR
verify full-range position ownership/key/liquidity in permanent custody
refund msg.value minus nativeDebt to payer; clear HKMN Permit2/ERC20 allowances
ownerSeedTransaction.failure: roll back seed-local state only and allow retry

preSeed.hookHkmn: the complete HKMN allocation is held at the hook and non-transferable to every other recipient until seed succeeds
preSeed.swaps: unavailable because the initialized pool has no liquidity

minimaAndGasCaps.moneyMinimums: every money minimum is an explicit TypedAmount

providerAttempt.notSent: pre-call failure; retryable before provider contact
providerAttempt.sentUnknown: post-send ambiguity; observation-only and never resent

chainAttempt.restart: revalidate persisted approvedSemanticsDigest before any rebroadcast

relaySettlement.amountEncoding: source and destination amounts are TypedAmount fields split into their named components; netDeltaAtomic is an integer string in destination-asset units
relaySettlement.transactionHashUniqueness: each sourceTxHash and destinationTxHash attributes to exactly one RelayLegV2 across all cycles and directions
relaySettlement.settlement: SETTLED only after independently authenticated source and destination finality with exact persisted request/leg attribution; native destination requires native-payment-proof.v1 and no ending balance delta or synthetic Transfer event; Solana evidence remains unchanged; Relay status alone never settles a leg
relaySettlement.fundingIsolation: outbound uses only the cycle claimed principal; return uses only the cycle-attributed proceeds delta

standingAuthority.firstUse: check wall-clock expiry and atomically persist the decision with its day-cap and nonce reservations before any signable action
standingAuthority.expiry: an expired authority is refused at first use
standingAuthority.replay: replaying the persisted decision is idempotent and cannot reserve a second cap or nonce

invariants: totalAtomic.amountAtomic equals unitPriceAtomic.amountAtomic multiplied by quantity
all money fields use the existing typed amount shape

cycleMode.persistence: stored in CycleRepository at creation and immutable for the cycle
cycleMode.isolation: production services refuse rehearsal cycles and rehearsal services refuse production cycles

custodyLedger.scope: Selected native ETH canonical row only; preserve historical ERC20 readers and the separate Solana evidence boundary
custodyLedger.verifiedCurrentBalance: CustodyBalanceObservationV1 | null; native identity requires an independent public/archive/public-recheck finalized native balance producer; null only on first-ever write; no observation erasure or schema downgrade
custodyLedger.obligations: tracked separately from verified balance; unresolved principal is counted once
custodyLedger.expectedCycleAsset: singular TypedAmount | null per row, never a collection; a second unresolved return-direction leg for the same resolved chain/asset is refused before append, leaving the row's existing value unchanged
custodyLedger.unattributedExternalDeposits: separate classification that pauses new claims
custodyLedger.admissionRule: Missing native observation with unresolved claim or current custody marks exposure unvalued; separately authenticate USD valuation for additional liquid exposure; reconcile reservations so principal is counted once

nonEvmEvidenceConstructionContract.trustInputs: a caller-pinned canonical {chainId, assetId, decimals, mint, owner, tokenProgramId} identity plus two independently configured finalized-commitment read sides; performs no RPC I/O and selects no chain/asset identity itself
nonEvmEvidenceConstructionContract.status: an allowed pure combiner shape only; not itself a durable producer, canonical chain/asset identity source, custody-ledger writer, valuation, or live readiness proof for any row

custodyLedger.liveBindingStatus: no bindings/index.json entry exists for this interface; none is created until a real, independently approved binding path, digest, and value exist

formats: Solana v0 with address lookup tables

wireSchema.authority: the runner canonical validator is authoritative
wireSchema.adapterDecoder: must emit the identical canonical schema

providerSpecificPurchasePolicy.trustInputs: binding bytes and expectedDigest are independently supplied and digest-verified before the schema is read; durable per-cycle facts; an independently observed RPC blockhash context; candidate transaction bytes are never a legal factory input and are evaluated only by this same hookemon.transaction-policy.v1 decode/evaluate kernel The exact generatePack profile admits Limit → Memo → Transfer → Price, a provider-only signed Memo ending :open, and duplicate identical operator authority. Its original blockhash is independently rechecked by RPC against an immutable minimum slot; recovery approval binds the full immutable rule sidecar and never alters original message bytes.
providerSpecificPurchasePolicy.liveBindingStatus: packages/adapters/src/app/stages/purchase.mjs resolves this factory behind two mutually exclusive seams -- a Node-test-only fixture and the productionBindingRegistry below -- but no live Collector program, account, provider co-signer, mint, expectedDigest source, or repository binding path is approved; no bindings/index.json entry exists for this interface and production composition has no path to a resolvable live entry

providerSpecificBuybackPolicy.trustInputs: binding bytes and expectedDigest are independently supplied and digest-verified before the schema is read; durable per-pack facts including the persisted quote/minimum/refund and the opened-asset/current-owner relation; an independently observed RPC blockhash context; candidate transaction bytes are never a legal factory input and are evaluated only by this same hookemon.transaction-policy.v1 decode/evaluate kernel; distinct from and never derived from the purchase binding schema
providerSpecificBuybackPolicy.liveBindingStatus: packages/adapters/src/app/stages/buyback.mjs resolves this factory only through the productionBindingRegistry below, per pack, before the provider buyback() call is awaited; no live Collector program, authority, recipient, proceeds account, discriminator, or expectedDigest source is approved; production composition has no path to a resolvable live entry

authorities.live: refused unless both purchase and buyback live anchors are present in the independently owner-approved frozen release binding manifest; at load and resolve time the selected entry must match its exact stage/provider/chain/path/digest anchor and its existing binding schema; caller-controlled registry bytes, expectedDigest, paths, and environment values never establish approval
authorities.synthetic-offline: resolves only after assertCollectorOfflineExecutionBoundary passes every one of its independent, composite checks together: production execution profile, no rehearsal configuration, the explicit authority selection, every actually-transport-read endpoint (Collector, Solana, both Robinhood RPCs, Relay) present and resolving to an explicit loopback http/https URL with no embedded userinfo, and config.signer.keychain.isolatedChildSetup being the exact object createIsolatedKeychainChildSetup returned (module-private WeakSet membership, never a value/shape match) with config.signer.keychain.command equal to that setup's own command, running the real live-signing protocol (signer.liveMode===true) against it -- liveMode is not itself an isolation signal, only the authenticated wrapper and endpoint confinement around it make it safe

environment: HOOKEMON_COLLECTOR_PRODUCTION_BINDING_AUTHORITY (accepts synthetic-offline under unchanged isolation guards, or live only when the frozen release contains both independently owner-approved anchors; validate authority availability before any credential-file-selector env var is read)
HOOKEMON_COLLECTOR_SYNTHETIC_ROOT (the isolated root createIsolatedKeychainChildSetup uses; required under synthetic-offline)
HOOKEMON_COLLECTOR_PRODUCTION_BINDING_REGISTRY_PATH (a JSON file read like any other config file this module reads; the path grants no authority, only the digest-validated content does)

under synthetic-offline, HOOKEMON_COLLECTOR_CRYPT_API_KEY_PATH is refused outright and the inline HOOKEMON_COLLECTOR_CRYPT_API_KEY/HOOKEMON_RELAY_API_KEY values must equal the fixed COLLECTOR_SYNTHETIC_API_KEY/RELAY_SYNTHETIC_API_KEY sentinels
configSurface.composeInjection: config.collectorProductionBindingRegistry -- a raw registry object/JSON text (from either the environment-sourced file or direct test/CLI injection, the same seam config.adapters already uses), validated by loadCollectorProductionBindingRegistry before compose.mjs attaches it as resolved.collectorCrypt.productionBindingRegistry; bin/hookemon-runner.mjs's compositionInput forwards it, and the constructed env.signer, from readEnvironment's output. config.signer.keychain.isolatedChildSetup is never an env var (an opaque WeakSet-branded object); the real bin/hookemon-runner.mjs entrypoint constructs it itself (applySyntheticIsolatedChildSetup, called from buildComposition once readEnvironment reports synthetic-offline) and overlays it onto env.signer.keychain before composition -- no test-only manual overlay or in-process config surgery is needed
configSurface.isolatedChildSetup: createIsolatedKeychainChildSetup({directory}) takes no caller-supplied security backend or command: it resolves the real bin/hookemon-keychain-signer.mjs, bin/hookemon-wallet.mjs, and test/fixtures/keychain/security all from this module's own import.meta.url root (never a caller-supplied path), requires directory to be an absolute, non-symlinked real directory, reuses an existing ephemeral identity at that root if present (never minting a replacement on every launch), and writes a wrapper (atomic temp-file-then-rename replace) spawning the fixed signer path with a minimal, explicitly allowlisted child environment (PATH pinned to the running interpreter's own directory, plus exactly the isolated backend's fixed variables, never process.env). The returned setup carries a digest over the wrapper's own bytes, re-verified at every point of use
configSurface.transportConfinement: createLoopbackConfinedFetch, threaded as fetchImpl into the Collector, Relay, and Solana RPC clients, and via viem's own http(url,{fetchFn}) transport into all three Robinhood/EVM construction sites (primary client, secondaryLogClient, archiveEvidenceClientFromConfig) compose.mjs's buildAdapters constructs only for the synthetic-offline authority, and into bin/hookemon-runner.mjs's own chainBroadcastTransports (the actual already-signed-byte EVM/Solana broadcast clients, constructed independently of compose.mjs's adapters) for the same authority; refuses a nonlocal request URL and refuses to follow a 3xx redirect response. No EVM exception and no unconfined broadcast path

liveAnchorContract.source: bindings/collector-live-release.json at the module-owned release root; canonical manifest digest must equal requireLiveMutationAuthority().bindingManifestDigest, and revisions must match
liveAnchorContract.cardinality: exactly two immutable entries: purchase and buyback; ordinary and supplementary buyback share the buyback entry
liveAnchorContract.approval: each separate collector-live-binding-approved receipt is produced through receipt add and binds the exact owner approval artifact and binding file; the manifest pins receipt and approval artifact byte hashes; implementation approval supplies no actual anchor approval
liveAnchorContract.identity: provider is collector-crypt; chainId is solana-mainnet; bindingPath is repository-relative within the frozen release; bindingDigest is the existing canonical SHA-256 binding digest
liveAnchorContract.verification: verify both receipt references and tuples during release freeze; authenticate the manifest digest through the existing live-authority gate; match the selected entry at both registry load and resolve before any Collector mutation
liveAnchorContract.rotation: any binding byte, path, stage or digest change requires fresh exact owner approval and a new frozen release; running cycles retain their admitted identity or refuse, never silently adopt a replacement
liveAnchorContract.unchanged: all per-stage schemas, legacy/no-ALT restriction, instruction/account and amount checks, finalized ownership, policy/canary/lease/finality/recovery checks and synthetic-offline confinement remain mandatory

collectorProductionBindingRegistry.liveBindingStatus: WIRED_NO_LIVE_ENTRY: fixed release anchors are authenticated; no actual owner-approved live binding artifacts or frozen manifest are shipped.

algorithm: prove completeness through second source or archive RPC

payout.finality: producer-authenticated exact native-payment-proof.v1 bound to persisted signed transaction; no ending recipient balance delta

durability.walletNonceLock: one repository-backed lock covers claim, outbound, return, and payout
durability.signedRecords: SIGNED records remain durable and recoverable after restart
durability.droppedBroadcast: resolve by receipt search or replacement using the same nonce and calldata
durability.rejectingRecipient: failed payment quarantines the unpaid liability; no success credit or automatic resend; other recipients continue
durability.dustCarry: persist and atomically consume provenance-bound carry between cycles

policyEngine.epicRule: hold iff offerAtomic * 100 < insuredValueAtomic * 40; equality sells
policyEngine.held: Pending epic decisions do not independently refuse claims; refuse only at the unchanged held count/cost limits or unresolved custody/valuation boundaries. Never auto-sell held cards.
policyEngine.rehearsal: runner mode with bounded cycles, cap, restart injection, and evidence JSON

nativeMigration.currency1: HKMN; reversed ordering and non-native quote configurations revert

feeAccounting.rounding: independent lifetime cumulative numerator/remainder per stream; never per-trade ceil or reset on claims
feeAccounting.conservation: funded wei conservation and cumulative numerator arithmetic are separate unit-correct invariants

nativeMigration.claimProof: ProcessClaimed is emitted only after successful native value payment; bind trusted hook runtime, cycle, decoded values and log index; reject balance-growth assumptions

seed.refundRecipient: payer, which may differ from launchAuthority

nativeMigration.history: Keep old readers; native execution rejects USDG fields, old money versions and old digests; no automatic journal/signature/receipt migration. Final nested wrapper inventory belongs to bot integration.

configuration.operatorControls: MicroUsdg suffix becomes MicroUsd; preserve 55/165/495 USD outer rails and tighter owner caps
configuration.releaseCostMicroUsd: independently authenticated commitment cost; never reuse the principal scalar as USD

usdControls.unit: integer-string micro-USD; not a transferable asset; no USDC/USD parity assumption
usdControls.heldCostBasis: attributed purchase cost only; no insured value, quote, or market-value substitute
usdControls.valuation: exact fetched quote amountUsd bound to request/quote digest, chain/currency/atomic amount and expiry; costs up, proceeds down; freeze cost basis at commitment
usdControls.missingValuation: refuse new risk; allow observation and authorized recovery

custody.expectedCycleAsset: singular TypedAmount or null; preserve once-only obligations
custody.gasSpent: separate native TypedAmount; never claimed principal, proceeds or entitlement

nativePaymentProof.producer: adapter-only authenticated RPC/release evidence; reauthenticate persisted proof after restart
nativePaymentProof.direct: persisted signed bytes/hash and sender nonce
nativePaymentProof.relay: exact request/order metadata, source finality, emitter runtime at finalized payment checkpoint, log index, recipient/value and successful inner payment; unique positive attribution; provider status alone is insufficient

nativeMigration.legacyFamily: Frozen and excluded; preserve shared FeeAccounting ERC20 transfer seam and historical embedded HKMNToken; no WETH fallback

publicAccounting.historicalVersions: Read-only; never relabel MicroUsdg as wei or USD
publicAccounting.valuationAuthority: Only attributable verified USD evidence; native principal and Collector USDC never imply USD parity
